theme.description: Définissez l’apparence et l’ambiance de {{app_name}} sur tous vos appareils.

profile.label: Profil

appearance.label: Apparence

notifications.label: Notifications
notifications.description: Contrôlez la manière et le moment où vous recevez des alertes, des e-mails et des mises à jour.

rights.title: Your Rights:
rights.message: Under GDPR and privacy laws, you can access, export, and delete your personal data at any time. All exports are provided in machine-readable JSON format.

gdpr.label: GDPR Compliance:
gdpr.message: Upon deletion, all personal data is permanently erased within 30 days as required by data protection regulations.

note.label: Privacy Note:
note.message: We use zero-knowledge encryption—we cannot read your conversations even when stored on the cloud.

export.title: Data Export
export.description: Export your personal data including profile, conversations, credit history, and activity logs.

card.title: Complete Data Export
card.description: Includes personal information, profile, session metadata, financial records, activity logs, and your data protection rights information.

backup.title: Cloud Backup
backup.description: Cloud backup is configured per session. Choose whether each session is stored in the cloud or kept local-only. All cloud data is encrypted end-to-end.

privacy.label: Privacy Note:
privacy.message: We use zero-knowledge encryption—we cannot read your conversations even when stored on the cloud.

delete.title: Delete All Data

cards.description: We cannot read your conversations. Only you have the encryption key.

card.description: Sessions are kept until you manually delete them. You can delete individual sessions or all data from the danger zone below.

delete.description: Permanently delete all your conversations and account data. This cannot be undone.
